title: FOIA Aggregator document text record (foia-document-text-export/1)
description: Extracted text of one released document. Parallel to foia-catalog-export/1 and joined to it by record_id. Only indexed text is exported; internal storage locations and download errors never are.

record_id.description: Same stable ID as the FC-13 catalog record.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text as exported.

truncated.description: True when extraction stopped at the configured character limit.

sha256.description: Hash of the archived binary the text came from.
